No Remorse! - July 2nd, 1942

Commander, the time has finally come.  The Soviets have launched a fierce counterattack on the German field marshal Erwin Rommel's forces, and crushed them into the snow.  French forces have withdrawn from the area, citing "a lack of proper supplies" as the reason for their withdrawal.  After reviewing your past performances, it has been decided you will lead the final attack on the Soviet capital of Moscow.  End Stalin's Iron Curtain over Eastern Europe and take the entire city, including the Kremlin. Communism dies here, Commander.  Show no pity, no remorse!
The Great War - A summary of the conflict from 1940-1945
The following excerpt has been taken from The Great War, a definitive
summary of the conflict that engulfed Europe from 1940-1945.  We are most grateful that the author has allowed us to take an excerpt from his book:

Though they had nearly been crushed into the snow of the Russian winter, the Allies had pushed the Soviets back from the borders of Germany all the way into Moscow.  The Germans, French and British, united in their common goal, attempted to enclose Moscow into a pocket from which no supplies could reach the city. However, the Soviets crushed Erwin Rommel's German Army Group B, and the French quickly retreated. The day might yet have been won, had the British commander not made several tactical misjudgements. As a result, the war which was so close to an end dragged on for three more years,
2011	culminating in the fall of Europe to communism. Britain, France and Germany all became Soviet vassal states, with only the United States remaining free.

Unfinished Business - May 28th, 1941

A coded radio transmission was intercepted from the Greek submarine facility before you captured it. Radio traces now indicate a secret Soviet sub base in Sweden was the reciever of the transmission. Air recons confirm that more of the advanced submarines are being produced there. Your job is to lead the attack on this facility Commander.If you can neutralize these subs, not only will Allied shipping be safe but we will be able to set up an invasion force to retake Soviet-held Scandanavia from this beachhead...

Our army lies broken.Now that the Soviets know where our main force will land, Scandinavia will be practically impenetrable.And the subs are free to wreak havoc on Allied supply ships. You're hereby put on permanent leave.
Good job Commander. Those blasted subs are now at the bottom of the sea, where they belonged in the first place. And now we can begin the liberation of Scandinavia...

Commander, it appears we have grossly underestimated the current situation with the Soviets. We thought they were stricktly on the defensive but now we know that was to be untrue. It seems that a very large force of Russian troops and armor has infiltrated our forward positions and is now bearing down on a critical road juncture. Commander, if a Russian force of this size gets into our rear we could be in big trouble.

You must move your forces as far forward as possible to meet and crush the attack. This is not exactly going to be a cakewalk Commander but if it was, we wouldn't be sending you. One more thing, G2 reports there may be a Russian airborne element on it's way. Be careful Commander and good luck!
